mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges in engineer coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in engineer coordination include miscommunication between different engineering teams, conflicting design specifications, and a lack of a centralized information hub. Another challenge is incorporating late design changes without impacting other disciplines. For Hometelligent Inc., we address this by utilizing a dedicated project manager who serves as a central point of contact and facilitates regular, structured meetings with all involved engineers to maintain clear communication and shared understanding.
